name: Eveready Industries India Ltd
tagline: A slow, steady Dabur-promoter-led battery-brand turnaround -- real but modest improvement, not a 10x growth story
business_overview: Eveready Industries is a century-old dry-cell battery, flashlight, and lighting manufacturer under the Eveready/Powercell/Uniross brands, now controlled by Dabur's Burman family (since a 2022 open-offer acquisition), undergoing a slow operational turnaround.
fundamentals_table: 14% / 17.2% (also cited as ROE 10.07%/ROIC 10.39% per an alternate source)
Poor 5yr CAGR (~3.11%) but recent YoY improving (~8-9%)
Stock down ~11.96% over the trailing year
fundamentals_narrative: A mature, low-growth consumer battery business (5yr revenue CAGR only ~3%) showing real but modest recent-quarter improvement -- Q1 FY27 EBITDA margins reached ~15% (up from historically single-digit levels) on cost discipline, a new Alkaline battery plant coming online, and a large one-off gain from divesting surplus Noida land.
sentiment_summary: Read the most recent 41 of 44 fetched posts (2015-01 to 2026-08, essentially the thread's full history), single batch (first-time read). This is a slow, steady, well-documented turnaround under new promoters (Dabur's Burman family since 2022) rather than a growth story -- trusted user ranvir has tracked every quarter from FY24 through Q1 FY27 (Aug 2026), showing gradual, real margin improvement (EBITDA margins moving from single digits toward ~15% by Q1 FY27) alongside one-off catalysts: a KKR arbitration settlement (Jul 2025) and a large Rs 118 Cr exceptional gain from divesting surplus Noida land (Q4 FY26).
community_signal: ranvir (trusted, elevated) has been the sole consistent tracker, delivering detailed quarterly concall summaries every quarter from FY24 through Q1 FY27 without exception -- a rare, high-quality longitudinal record showing steady (not dramatic) margin improvement. Malhar_Manek (trusted, elevated) gave the original 2022 promoter-change thesis write-up when the Burman family (Dabur) took control via open offer.
bull_case: Credible, well-capitalized new promoter group (Dabur's Burman family) driving a multi-year operational clean-up since 2022
Real, gradual margin improvement each quarter (EBITDA margins climbing toward ~15% by Q1 FY27 from single digits historically)
Non-recurring catalysts realized: KKR arbitration settled, surplus Noida land divested for a large exceptional gain, freeing balance sheet for further monetization
bear_case: The core battery category is mature and low-growth (5yr revenue CAGR only ~3%), capping the ceiling for a 10x/2-3yr thesis regardless of margin execution
Improvement has been genuinely gradual (multiple years, still modest EBITDA margins) rather than a sharp inflection
Stock is down over the trailing year despite the turnaround narrative, suggesting the market has not yet rewarded the improvement
verdict_headline: A genuine, well-documented turnaround under credible new promoters, but a mature battery category caps the growth ceiling
verdict_reasoning: Both trailing (weak, ~3% 5yr CAGR) and recent (modest, single-digit-to-low-teens % improvement) trends are real but far from explosive, and the category itself (batteries/flashlights) does not offer a plausible path to 10x revenue or profit in 2-3 years
This is a legitimate quality-turnaround watch (credible promoters, steady execution, one-off balance-sheet catalysts) but does not fit this project's growth-thesis framework
Not filtered out entirely given the genuine, consistently-tracked improvement, but assessed as thesis_fit neither rather than a 10x candidate
